title: BanglishHallu Phase 1 record
description: Frozen at M0. Adding a field is allowed; renaming, removing or repurposing one is not - it breaks Phase 2 inheritance. See docs/PRD.md section 5.1 and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md section 2.

pair_id.description: Groups a question with its faithful and hallucinated answers. Splits MUST be grouped on this.

source.description: Must have a matching entry in data/SOURCES.md before ingestion (PRD D10).

source_corpus.description: Upstream content origin, e.g. 'bengali_wikipedia+bcs_question_banks'. Must match an entry in data/SOURCES.md (PRD D10).

context.description: Empty string when condition is no_context.

label.description: PROJECT-WIDE CONVENTION (PRD 5.1a): 1 = CORRECT / FAITHFUL, 0 = INCORRECT / HALLUCINATED. An is-it-correct? flag. This matches the bn_qa_pool source files natively, so no flip is applied anywhere in the pipeline. Note the positive class (1) is faithful, not hallucinated - the reverse of much of the literature.

hallucination_type.description: Intrinsic (has_context): entity, numeric, relational, contradiction. Extrinsic (no_context): fabricated, overclaim. Faithful class (label == 1): none. 'unlabeled' is PROVISIONAL for un-annotated interim data only and must never appear in a released split (PRD D8).

provenance.description: How the record's text was produced. PRD D6 - at least 500 items must be human_written. 'llm_generated' = QA pair built with LLM assistance from source text (Wikipedia / BCS banks); see data/SOURCES.md. Keeping this accurate is what makes the generated-vs-human comparison (PRD D7, V4) possible.

script_condition.description: Phase 2 payload. Populate, do not evaluate on it in Phase 1.

cmi_method.description: script_proxy is only valid for text with no romanised Bangla.

error_span.description: Phase 2 payload. Capture at generation time; not evaluated in Phase 1.

x-invariants: no pair_id may appear in more than one split
released splits must contain no 'unlabeled' values
